name: Handstand Push Up
instructions: Face a wall and kick up into a handstand with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your head toward the floor under control.
Press back up until your arms are fully extended.
Come down from the handstand safely.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A vertical pressing exercise performed upside down against a wall that builds shoulder and triceps strength.
